   253	/-! ### The dévissage frame for full algebraic generic freeness
   254	
   255	Grothendieck's generic-freeness lemma (blueprint
   256	`thm:generic_flatness_algebraic`, Nitsure §4 "Lemma on Generic Flatness"):
   257	for `A` a noetherian domain, `B` a finite-type `A`-algebra and `M` a finite
   258	`B`-module there is `f ≠ 0` in `A` with `M_f` free over `A_f`.
   259	
   260	Nitsure's proof has two layers: a *dévissage* (prime filtration of `M` as a
   261	module over the noetherian ring `B`, reducing to `M = B/𝔭`, via the splicing
   262	fact that generic freeness is stable under extensions), and a *domain core*
   263	(`M = B/𝔭`: Noether normalisation over `Frac A` + clearing denominators +
   264	the generic-rank exact sequence + induction on fibre dimension). This
   265	section proves both layers completely — the splicing lemma
   266	`genericallyFree_of_exact` (via `ModuleCat.free_shortExact` and the
   267	localization-transport lemma `free_localizedModule_powers_mul`), the torsion
   268	base case `genericallyFree_of_torsion` (Nitsure's `n = -1`), the domain core
   269	`genericallyFree_quotient_prime` (Noether normalisation +
   270	`genericallyFree_quotient_prime_of_fibre_dim_le`), and the assembly
   271	`genericFlatnessAlgebraic` via
   272	`IsNoetherianRing.induction_on_isQuotientEquivQuotientPrime`. -/
   273	
   274	/-- The **generic-freeness property** of an `A`-module `M`: some localization
   275	`M_f` at a single non-zero `f ∈ A` is a free module over `A_f`. This is the
   276	conclusion shared by every statement of this section. -/
   277	def GenericallyFree (A : Type*) (M : Type*) [CommRing A] [AddCommGroup M]
   278	    [Module A M] : Prop :=
   279	  ∃ f : A, f ≠ 0 ∧
   280	    Module.Free (Localization.Away f) (LocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f) M)
   281	
   282	/-- Generic freeness transports along enlarging the inverted element: if `M_f`
   283	is free over `A_f` then `M_{fg}` is free over `A_{fg}` for every `g`. The
   284	proof is base-change associativity
   285	`A_{fg} ⊗_{A_f} (A_f ⊗_A M) ≅ A_{fg} ⊗_A M` together with freeness of base
   286	change (`Module.Free.tensor`); the two tensor legs are identified with the
   287	localized modules by `IsLocalizedModule.isBaseChange`. -/

    57	/-- **The `S`-span of the range of an `R`-linear map out of a finite `R`-module is `S`-finite.**
    58	For an `R`-algebra `S`, a finite `R`-module `M`, and a scalar-tower `S`-module `N`, the
    59	`S`-submodule `Submodule.span S (Set.range f)` generated by the image of `f : M →ₗ[R] N` is a
    60	finite `S`-module: a finite `R`-generating set `T` of `M` yields the finite `S`-generating set
    61	`f '' T` (every `f m` is an `R`-combination of the `f tᵢ`, hence an `S`-combination).  Pure
    62	algebra; the finiteness route for the concrete colength `N z`. -/
    63	theorem Module.Finite.span_range_of_finite_isScalarTower
    64	    {R S M N : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    65	    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    66	    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module S N] [IsScalarTower R S N]
    67	    (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    68	    Module.Finite S (Submodule.span S (Set.range f)) := by
    69	  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := (Module.Finite.fg_top (R := R) (M := M))
    70	  have hspan : Submodule.span S (Set.range f) = Submodule.span S (f '' T) := by
    71	    apply le_antisymm
    72	    · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    73	      rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩
    74	      have hm : m ∈ Submodule.span R (T : Set M) := by rw [hT]; trivial
    75	      have hfm : f m ∈ Submodule.span R (f '' T) := by
    76	        rw [← Submodule.map_span]
    77	        exact Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hm
    78	      exact (Submodule.span_le_restrictScalars R S (f '' T)) hfm
    79	    · exact Submodule.span_mono (Set.image_subset_range f T)
    80	  rw [hspan]
    81	  exact Module.Finite.iff_fg.mpr (Submodule.fg_span (T.finite_toSet.image f))

    95	/-- **The concrete chart-level colength `N z`** (I-0302 §residual 2a): the `Γ(V)`-submodule of

   100	noncomputable def chartColengthModule (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) (b : Bool)
   101	    (s : relThetaSections C R π a) :
   102	    Submodule Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)

   106	    ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R (Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s})).toLinearMap.comp

   112	    (s : relThetaSections C R π a) {ψ : relThetaSections C R π a} (hψ : ψ ∈ K) :

   114	        (relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) ψ) ∈ chartColengthModule K b s :=

   129	`read ψ` lies in `N z`, so `h • [read ψ] = 0`, i.e. `[h · read ψ] = 0`, i.e.
   130	`h · read ψ ∈ ⟨read s⟩`. -/

   132	    (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) (b : Bool)
   133	    (s : relThetaSections C R π a)
   134	    {h : Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)}

   143	  have hz' : h • Ideal.Quotient.mk I (relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) ψ) = 0 := by

certified representative `G` of the restriction of `F₀` and a pair-chart framing of
`ε (DivFam.mk G)`, the restriction of `v` composes with `divSchemeι` to the chart
morphism of the framing.  Quantifying over all tests and all representatives makes
the clause stable under refinement of covers and change of representative by
construction — F6's Law 1/Law 2 consume it without unfolding any choice. -/
def IsDivRepClassify (F₀ : DivFamZar C S π g)
    (v : Spec (CommRingCat.of S) ⟶
      DivScheme k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
        (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁
        (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm)) : Prop :=
  ∀ (T : Type u) [CommRing T] [Algebra k T] [Algebra S T] [IsScalarTower k S T]
    (G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C T π g),
    (DivFam.mk G).toZar = DivFamZar.mapAlg T g F₀ →
    ∀ (i : (glueData k g r₁).J) (j : (glueData k g r₂).J)
      (w : PairChartRing k g r₁ g r₂ i j →ₐ[k] T),
      (Module.Grassmannian.map w (pairTautFst k g r₁ r₂ i j)).toSubmodule
          = Submodule.map (LinearMap.baseChange T b₁.equivFun.toLinearMap)
              (divFamEps hπ g (DivFam.mk G)).1 →
      (Module.Grassmannian.map w (pairTautSnd k g r₁ r₂ i j)).toSubmodule
          = Submodule.map (LinearMap.baseChange T b₂.equivFun.toLinearMap)
              (divFamEps hπ g (DivFam.mk G)).2 →
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S T))
          ≫ v ≫ divSchemeι k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
            (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁
            (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm)
        = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom w.toRingHom) ≫ pairChartMap k g r₁ g r₂ i j

/-- **Existence half of the backward classification** (w4-ddr9 §2.1 steps 3 and 5):
the per-piece `divClassify` outputs over the composite certificate × frame cover —
with the carve discharged by DDR-9.0 (`divFamEps_carve`) — glue to a morphism
`Spec S ⟶ DivScheme g` satisfying the characterizing clause. -/
theorem exists_isDivRepClassify (F₀ : DivFamZar C S π g) :
    ∃ v : Spec (CommRingCat.of S) ⟶
        DivScheme k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
          (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁
          (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm),
      IsDivRepClassify hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀ v := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨m, r, hspan, hdata⟩ :=
    DivFamZar.exists_certChartCover hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀
  choose G ci cj cw hZ hcw₁ hcw₂ using hdata
  have hv : ∀ p : Fin m,
      ∃ vp : Spec (CommRingCat.of (Localization.Away (r p))) ⟶
        DivScheme k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
          (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁
          (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm),
      DivClassifyClause hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ (DivFam.mk (G p)) vp := fun p =>
    (divClassify hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ (DivFam.mk (G p))
      (fun a => divFamEps_carve C π hπ g (Localization.Away (r p)) (G p) a)).exists
  choose v hvc using hv
  have hglue : ∀ p q : Fin m,
      pullback.fst ((Scheme.affineOpenCoverOfSpanRangeEqTop
          (R := CommRingCat.of S) r hspan).openCover.f p)
        ((Scheme.affineOpenCoverOfSpanRangeEqTop
          (R := CommRingCat.of S) r hspan).openCover.f q) ≫ v p
      = pullback.snd _ _ ≫ v q := fun p q =>
    pullback_divClassifyClause_compat hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀
      (DivFam.mk (G p)) (DivFam.mk (G q)) (hZ p) (hZ q) (hvc p) (hvc q)
  refine ⟨(Scheme.affineOpenCoverOfSpanRangeEqTop
    (R := CommRingCat.of S) r hspan).openCover.glueMorphisms v hglue, ?_⟩
  intro T _ _ _ _ GT hGT i j ω hω₁ hω₂
  refine Scheme.Cover.hom_ext
    ((Scheme.affineOpenCoverOfSpanRangeEqTop
      (R := CommRingCat.of S) r hspan).openCover.pullback₁
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S T))))
    _ _ fun p => ?_
  change pullback.fst _ _ ≫ _ = pullback.fst _ _ ≫ _
  rw [← Category.assoc, pullback.condition, Category.assoc,
    Scheme.Cover.ι_glueMorphisms_assoc]
  exact (pullback_chart_divClassifyClause_compat hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀
    GT hGT ω hω₁ hω₂ (DivFam.mk (G p)) (hZ p) (hvc p)).symm

/-- **Uniqueness / full choice-independence** (w4-ddr9 §2.1 step 6): any two
morphisms satisfying the characterizing clause for `F₀` agree — compare over the
composite certificate × frame cover (`divScheme_hom_ext` per piece,
`Scheme.Cover.hom_ext` globally).  In particular the classified morphism does not
depend on the choice of representatives, certificate cover, or frame covers. -/
theorem isDivRepClassify_unique (F₀ : DivFamZar C S π g)
    {v v' : Spec (CommRingCat.of S) ⟶
      DivScheme k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
        (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁
        (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm)}
    (hv : IsDivRepClassify hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀ v)
    (hv' : IsDivRepClassify hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀ v') : v = v' := by
  obtain ⟨m, r, hspan, hdata⟩ :=
    DivFamZar.exists_certChartCover hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀
  choose G ci cj cw hZ hcw₁ hcw₂ using hdata
  refine Scheme.Cover.hom_ext
    (Scheme.affineOpenCoverOfSpanRangeEqTop
      (R := CommRingCat.of S) r hspan).openCover _ _ fun p => ?_
  refine divScheme_hom_ext k _ _ g r₁ r₂ b₁ (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm)
    _ _ ?_
  have h1 : (Scheme.affineOpenCoverOfSpanRangeEqTop
        (R := CommRingCat.of S) r hspan).openCover.f p
        ≫ v ≫ divSchemeι k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
          (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁
          (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm)
      = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (cw p).toRingHom)
          ≫ pairChartMap k g r₁ g r₂ (ci p) (cj p) :=
    hv (Localization.Away (r p)) (G p) (hZ p) (ci p) (cj p) (cw p) (hcw₁ p) (hcw₂ p)
  have h2 : (Scheme.affineOpenCoverOfSpanRangeEqTop
        (R := CommRingCat.of S) r hspan).openCover.f p
        ≫ v' ≫ divSchemeι k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
          (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁
          (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm)
      = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (cw p).toRingHom)
          ≫ pairChartMap k g r₁ g r₂ (ci p) (cj p) :=
    hv' (Localization.Away (r p)) (G p) (hZ p) (ci p) (cj p) (cw p) (hcw₁ p) (hcw₂ p)
  rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc]
  exact h1.trans h2.symm

include hO hχ in
/-- **The ∃!-keystone of the backward direction** (w4-ddr9 §2.1): a locally
certified divisor class over an affine test classifies to a UNIQUE morphism
`Spec S ⟶ DivScheme g` satisfying the characterizing clause. -/
theorem divClassifyZar (F₀ : DivFamZar C S π g) :
    ∃! v : Spec (CommRingCat.of S) ⟶
        DivScheme k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
          (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁
          (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm),
      IsDivRepClassify hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀ v := by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_isDivRepClassify hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀
  exact ⟨v, hv, fun v' hv' =>
    isDivRepClassify_unique hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀ hv' hv⟩

     9	# The Jacobian representability datum (Wave-4 seam D1, `JacobianData`)
    10	
    11	The pinned representability datum for the degree-zero étale-sheafified relative Picard
    12	functor `pic0Functor C` of the challenge curve: a representing object `J`, an honest
    13	`Functor.RepresentableBy` datum (no `Nonempty`, no choice), and the two construction
    14	certificates (`LocallyOfFiniteType`, `QuasiCompact`).  This is the frozen Wave-4
    15	interface shape (`informal/w4-datum-worksheet.md` §1.1, verbatim), together with the
    16	design-§5 consumers `grpObj` / `homEquiv` / `uniqueUpToIso` — and nothing else.
    17	
    18	## Ownership split (binding, w5-worksheet D1)
    19	
    20	* The **producer** `jacobianData C : JacobianData C`, the quasi-compactness certificate,
    21	  and the discharge of the frozen `Jacobian`/`instGrpObj` sorries of `Challenge.lean`
    22	  are **DAT-J property** (the parallel Wave-4 fleet).  None of them lives here.
    23	* This file is the **Wave-5/6/7 consumption interface**: downstream files take
    24	  `(d : JacobianData C)` as a section variable, activate the group structure per proof
    25	  via `letI := d.grpObj` (or `attribute [local instance] JacobianData.grpObj`), and
    26	  phrase every statement about `d.J`.  At DAT-J discharge time the frozen gate
    27	  instantiates them by `exact theorem_x … (jacobianData C)` — definitionally, since
    28	  `Jacobian C := (jacobianData C).J`.
    29	* Extensions to this file are **additive only**; the structure shape never changes.
    30	
    31	## The `forget₂ ⋙ forget` massage
    32	
    33	`rep` is typed against `(pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) ⋙ forget GrpCat`
    34	so that mathlib's `GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy` applies **verbatim** with
    35	`F := pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat`.  The functor value at a test `T` is
    36	*definitionally* the coerced subgroup `↥(pic0Subgroup C T)`; `homEquiv` and
    37	`homEquiv_comp` below own this defeq once, exposing the equivalence against
    38	`pic0Subgroup C T` and the naturality against `pic0Map` — no consumer ever meets the
    39	`forget₂ ⋙ forget` spelling again.
    40	
    41	## η-defeq verdict (recon §5 "lower-order unknown", RECORDED)
    42	
    43	**POSITIVE, with one keying caveat.**  `Over.mk d.J.hom` is definitionally equal to
    44	`d.J` (structure-eta for `Comma`/`CostructuredArrow` plus unit-like eta for the
    45	`Discrete PUnit` right leg): the ascription
    46	`(d.grpObj : GrpObj (Over.mk d.J.hom))` elaborates as-is, so **no transport lemma is
    47	ever needed**.  Caveat: bare instance *search* does not unfold `Over.mk` on its own,
    48	so a consumer of `smooth_of_grpObj` — whose group hypothesis is `[GrpObj (Over.mk f)]`
    49	at `f := d.J.hom` — must key the instance at the `Over.mk` spelling:
    50	`letI : GrpObj (Over.mk d.J.hom) := d.grpObj` (pure defeq, zero cost; mathlib itself
    51	uses the same ascription idiom in `Group/Smooth.lean`).  Instances stated directly on
    52	`G : Over (Spec (.of K))` (e.g. `IsClosedImmersion η[G].left`) fire on `d.J` with no
    53	massage at all.  The `example`-level smoke tests at the bottom of this file are the
    54	machine-checked record; the T-chain (tangent lane) and S2 (`Smooth` via
    55	`smooth_of_grpObj`) may rely on this freely.
    56	
    57	## Main declarations
    58	
    59	* `AlgebraicGeometry.JacobianData C` — the frozen datum structure.
    60	* `AlgebraicGeometry.JacobianData.grpObj` — the group-object structure on `d.J` via
    61	  `GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy` (the discharge route of the frozen `instGrpObj`).
    62	* `AlgebraicGeometry.JacobianData.homEquiv` / `homEquiv_comp` — the universal property
    63	  in consumer form: `(T ⟶ d.J) ≃ pic0Subgroup C T`, natural against `pic0Map`.
    64	* `AlgebraicGeometry.JacobianData.uniqueUpToIso` / `homEquiv_uniqueUpToIso_hom` — any
    65	  two data have canonically isomorphic representing objects (Wave-7's `baseChangeIso`
    66	  mechanism), with the intertwining property.
    67	-/

    69	set_option autoImplicit false
    70	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    71	
    72	universe u
    73	
    74	open CategoryTheory Opposite
    75	
    76	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    77	
    78	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
    79	
    80	/-- **The pinned representability datum** for the degree-zero étale-sheafified relative
    81	Picard functor of the curve `C` (w4-datum-worksheet §1.1, frozen).  Produced once, by
    82	explicit construction, in Wave 4 (DAT-J: `jacobianData`); consumed as a section
    83	variable everywhere else.  NEVER a sorried instance, NEVER `Nonempty` + choice.
    84	
    85	The typing of `rep` is chosen so that `GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy` applies verbatim with
    86	`F := pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat` (see `JacobianData.grpObj`). -/
    87	structure JacobianData (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    88	    [IsProper C.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
    89	    Type (u + 1) where
    90	  /-- The representing object (the Jacobian-to-be). -/
    91	  J : Over (Spec (.of k))
    92	  /-- The pinned universal datum: `Hom(T, J) ≃ Pic⁰(T)`, naturally in the test `T`. -/
    93	  rep : ((pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) ⋙ forget GrpCat).RepresentableBy J
    94	  /-- Certificate from the construction (Kleiman 4.8(1) shape); NOT re-derived via the
    95	  EGA limit criterion. -/
    96	  locallyOfFiniteType : LocallyOfFiniteType J.hom
    97	  /-- Certificate from the construction (a posteriori: `|J|` is the image of a
    98	  quasi-compact divisor scheme under the Abel map).  Feeds `IsProper` (Wave 5) via
    99	  `finite type = qc + lft`. -/
   100	  quasiCompact : QuasiCompact J.hom
   101	
   102	namespace JacobianData
   103	
   104	variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   105	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   106	
   107	/-- The group-object structure on the representing object, via mathlib's
   108	`GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy` — this is the (definitional) discharge route of the frozen
   109	`Jacobian.instGrpObj`.  Not a global instance here (the datum is a section variable);
   110	activate per proof with `letI := d.grpObj` or
   111	`attribute [local instance] JacobianData.grpObj`. -/
   112	@[implicit_reducible]
   113	noncomputable def grpObj (d : JacobianData C) : GrpObj d.J :=
   114	  GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy d.J (pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) d.rep
   115	
   116	/-- **The universal property, consumer form**: morphisms into `d.J` are degree-zero
   117	étale Picard classes.  This accessor owns the `forget₂ ⋙ forget` defeq massage once:
   118	the target is the honest subgroup carrier `pic0Subgroup C T`. -/
   119	def homEquiv (d : JacobianData C) {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} :
   120	    (T ⟶ d.J) ≃ pic0Subgroup C T :=
   121	  d.rep.homEquiv
   122	
   123	/-- Naturality of `homEquiv` against the degree-zero restriction maps `pic0Map`
   124	(element form of the `RepresentableBy` naturality, with the functor value unfolded
   125	through `forget₂ ⋙ forget`). -/
   126	theorem homEquiv_comp (d : JacobianData C) {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   127	    (f : T' ⟶ T) (g : T ⟶ d.J) :
   128	    d.homEquiv (f ≫ g) = pic0Map C f (d.homEquiv g) :=
   129	  d.rep.homEquiv_comp f g
   130	
   131	/-- Representing objects are unique up to isomorphism (mathlib
   132	`Functor.RepresentableBy.uniqueUpToIso`): any two Jacobian data for the same curve have
   133	canonically isomorphic `J`.  This is Wave-7's `baseChangeIso` mechanism. -/
   134	noncomputable def uniqueUpToIso (d d' : JacobianData C) : d.J ≅ d'.J :=
   135	  d.rep.uniqueUpToIso d'.rep
   136	
   137	/-- The intertwining property of `uniqueUpToIso`: composing with the canonical
   138	isomorphism commutes with the two universal properties. -/
   139	theorem homEquiv_uniqueUpToIso_hom (d d' : JacobianData C) {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   140	    (f : T ⟶ d.J) :
   141	    d'.homEquiv (f ≫ (d.uniqueUpToIso d').hom) = d.homEquiv f := by
   142	  have h : (d.uniqueUpToIso d').hom = d'.rep.homEquiv.symm (d.rep.homEquiv (𝟙 d.J)) := rfl
   143	  rw [homEquiv, homEquiv, h, Functor.RepresentableBy.comp_homEquiv_symm]
   144	  exact (d'.rep.homEquiv.apply_symm_apply _).trans (d.rep.homEquiv_eq f).symm
   145	
   146	end JacobianData

   112	
   113	/-- The ideal-theoretic colength module is exactly the previously defined `B`-span of the
   114	classes of the chart readings. -/
   115	theorem chartIdealColengthModule_eq_chartColengthModule
   116	    (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) (b : Bool)
   117	    (s : relThetaSections C R π a) :
   118	    chartIdealColengthModule K b s = chartColengthModule K b s := by
   119	  rw [chartIdealColengthModule, chartReadIdeal, Submodule.map_span, chartColengthModule]
   120	  congr 1
   121	  ext x
   122	  constructor
   123	  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨m, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
   124	    exact ⟨m, rfl⟩
   125	  · rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩
   126	    exact ⟨chartReadMap K b m, ⟨m, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
   127	
   128	/-- The scalar-extension presentation of the chart-reading ideal after quotienting by the
   129	chosen section. -/
   130	noncomputable def chartIdealColengthMap
   131	    (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) (b : Bool)
   132	    (s : relThetaSections C R π a) :
   133	    Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b) ⊗[R] ↥K →ₗ[Γ(relCurve C R,
   134	      relPinnedChart C R π b)]
   135	      (Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b) ⧸
   136	        Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s}) :=
   137	  LinearMap.liftBaseChange Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)
   138	    ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R (Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s})).toLinearMap.comp
   139	      (chartReadMap K b))
   140	
   141	set_option maxHeartbeats 2400000 in
   142	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 800000 in
   143	/-- The range of the quotient scalar-extension map is the ideal-theoretic colength module. -/
   144	theorem range_chartIdealColengthMap
   145	    (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) (b : Bool)
   146	    (s : relThetaSections C R π a) :
   147	    LinearMap.range (chartIdealColengthMap K b s) = chartIdealColengthModule K b s := by
   148	  rw [chartIdealColengthModule_eq_chartColengthModule]
   149	  simpa only [chartIdealColengthMap, chartColengthModule] using
   150	    (LinearMap.range_liftBaseChange_eq_span
   151	      (R := R) (B := Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b))
   152	      (M := ↥K)
   153	      (N := Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b) ⧸
   154	        Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s})
   155	      ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R
   156	        (Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s})).toLinearMap.comp
   157	          (chartReadMap K b)))
   158	
   159	end ThetaGeneratorSeed
   160	
   161	end AlgebraicGeometry

    10	/-!
    11	# The universal multiplication span
    12	
    13	This file records the relative product map from the multiplier window and the
    14	universal first window into the universal shifted window.  The map is written
    15	using a finite basis of the multiplier space; its range is therefore the
    16	finite `R_Z`-linear multiplication span.  The carve containment is proved in
    17	the companion theorem below.
    18	-/
    19	
    20	set_option autoImplicit false
    21	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    22	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 8
    23	
    24	universe u
    25	
    26	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
    27	open scoped TensorProduct
    28	
    29	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    30	
    31	open Scheme Grassmannian
    32	
    33	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    34	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π]
    35	
    36	noncomputable local instance instOverCleftMulSpan :
    37	    C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
    38	
    39	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsIntegral C.left]
    40	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    41	  [IsDominant π]
    42	variable [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
    43	  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
    44	variable (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    45	variable (g r₁ r₂ : ℕ)
    46	variable (b₁ : Module.Basis (Fin r₁) k
    47	  ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤))
    48	variable (b₂ : Module.Basis (Fin r₂) k
    49	  ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k ((windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
    50	    + (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)) ⊤))
    51	variable (i : (glueData k g r₁).J) (j : (glueData k g r₂).J)
    52	
    53	local notation "RZ" => DivCarveChartRing k
    54	  (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
    55	  (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j
    56	local notation "HS" => ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k
    57	  (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤)
    58	local notation "HM" => ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k
    59	  (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤)
    60	local notation "HMS" => ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k
    61	  ((windowM_choice π hπ g + windowS_choice π hπ g) • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤)
    62	local notation "K₁" => ↥(divUniversalFstWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule
    63	local notation "K₂" => ↥(divUniversalSndWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule
    64	
    65	/-! ## The finite source and its multiplication map -/
    66	
    67	/-- A finite free-indexed source for the universal multiplication span. -/
    68	noncomputable def universalMulSource : Type u := Fin (Module.finrank k HS) → K₁
    69	
    70	/-- The sum of all multiplier-basis translates of the first universal window. -/
    71	noncomputable def universalMulMap : universalMulSource C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j →ₗ[RZ]
    72	    RZ ⊗[k] HMS :=
    73	  ∑ t : Fin (Module.finrank k HS),
    74	    (LinearMap.baseChange RZ (windowShiftMul hπ g ((Module.finBasis k HS) t))).comp
    75	      ((divUniversalFstWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule.subtype.comp
    76	        (LinearMap.proj t))
    77	
    78	/-- The relative submodule spanned by all products of a multiplier-window
    79	basis vector with the universal first window. -/
    80	noncomputable def universalMulSpan : Submodule RZ (RZ ⊗[k] HMS) :=
    81	  LinearMap.range (universalMulMap C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j)
    82	
    83	theorem finite_universalMulSource :
    84	    Module.Finite RZ (universalMulSource C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j) := by
    85	  letI := (divUniversalFstWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).finite_quotient
    86	  letI := (divUniversalFstWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).projective_quotient
    87	  letI : Module.Finite RZ K₁ :=
    88	    finite_submodule_of_projective_quotient
    89	      (divUniversalFstWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule
    90	  infer_instance
    91	
    92	/-! ## Carve containment -/
    93	
    94	/-- The coordinate universal pair satisfies the carve over its chart ring. -/
    95	private theorem universal_coordinate_carve (a : HS) :
    96	    carvePairArrow
    97	        (divCarveMul k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
    98	          (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ a)
    99	        (divUniversalFst k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   100	          (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule
   101	        (divUniversalSnd k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   102	          (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule = 0 := by
   103	  change carvePairArrow
   104	      (divCarveMul k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   105	        (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ a)
   106	      (LinearMap.ker (Module.Grassmannian.baseChangeMkQ RZ
   107	        (pairTautFst k g r₁ r₂ i j).toSubmodule))
   108	      (LinearMap.ker (Module.Grassmannian.baseChangeMkQ RZ
   109	        (pairTautSnd k g r₁ r₂ i j).toSubmodule)) = 0
   110	  exact divUniversal_carve k
   111	    (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   112	    (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j RZ a
   113	
   114	/-- The universal pair in the transported window ambients satisfies the
   115	`windowShiftMul` carve. -/
   116	theorem universal_window_carve (a : HS) :
   117	    carvePairArrow (windowShiftMul hπ g a)
   118	      (divUniversalFstWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule
   119	      (divUniversalSndWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule = 0 := by
   120	  let e₁ : (Fin r₁ → k) ≃ₗ[k] HM := b₁.equivFun.symm
   121	  let e₂ : (Fin r₂ → k) ≃ₗ[k] HMS :=
   122	    b₂.equivFun.symm.trans (seedWindowShiftEquiv C π hπ g)
   123	  let μ : (Fin r₁ → k) →ₗ[k] (Fin r₂ → k) :=
   124	    divCarveMul k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   125	      (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ a
   126	  have hμ : e₂.toLinearMap ∘ₗ μ ∘ₗ e₁.symm.toLinearMap = windowShiftMul hπ g a := by
   127	    refine LinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
   128	    simp [e₁, e₂, μ, divCarveMul, windowShiftMul, LinearMap.comp_apply]
   129	  have hcoord := universal_coordinate_carve C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j a
   130	  have htransport :=
   131	    (Grassmannian.carvePairArrow_map_baseChange_eq_zero_iff e₁ e₂ μ
   132	      (divUniversalFst k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   133	        (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule
   134	      (divUniversalSnd k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   135	        (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule).mpr hcoord
   136	  rw [hμ] at htransport
   137	  exact htransport
   138	
   139	/-! ## The span containment -/
   140	
   141	theorem universalMulMap_range_le :
   142	    LinearMap.range (universalMulMap C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j) ≤
   143	      (divUniversalSndWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule := by
   144	  rw [LinearMap.range_le_iff]
   145	  intro v
   146	  rw [universalMulMap]
   147	  apply Submodule.sum_mem
   148	  intro t ht
   149	  have hcarve := carvePairArrow_eq_zero_iff (R := RZ)
   150	    (windowShiftMul hπ g ((Module.finBasis k HS) t))
   151	    (divUniversalFstWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule
   152	    (divUniversalSndWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule |>.mp
   153	    (universal_window_carve C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j ((Module.finBasis k HS) t))
   154	  exact hcarve (v t).1 (v t).2
   155	
   156	theorem universalMulSpan_le :
   157	    universalMulSpan C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j ≤
   158	      (divUniversalSndWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule := by
   159	  exact universalMulMap_range_le C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j
   160	
   161	/-- The product map corestricted to the universal second window.  Its residue-
   162	field surjectivity is the only remaining input needed by
   163	`RigidEngine.surjective_of_forall_rTensor_residueField_surjective`. -/
   164	noncomputable def universalMulMapToSnd :
   165	    universalMulSource C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j →ₗ[RZ] K₂ :=
   166	  (universalMulMap C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).codRestrict _ fun v =>
   167	    universalMulMap_range_le C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j
   168	      (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ v)
   169	
   170	theorem finite_universalMulSpan :
   171	    Module.Finite RZ ↥(universalMulSpan C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j) := by
   172	  letI := finite_universalMulSource C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j
   173	  infer_instance
   174	
   175	end AlgebraicGeometry

    12	/-!
    13	# The residue-fibre multiplication map
    14	
    15	This file isolates the tensor bookkeeping between the finite relative product
    16	map and the field-level multiplication-span theorem.  Tensoring the finite
    17	product source commutes with its finite product, and under that equivalence the
    18	base-changed map is the sum of the base-changed multiplier-basis components.
    19	-/
    20	
    21	set_option autoImplicit false
    22	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    23	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 8
    24	
    25	universe u
    26	
    27	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite

    29	
    30	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    31	
    32	open Scheme Grassmannian
    33	
    34	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    35	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π]
    36	
    37	noncomputable local instance instOverCleftMulSpanFibre :
    38	    C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
    39	
    40	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsIntegral C.left]
    41	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    42	  [IsDominant π]
    43	variable [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
    44	  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
    45	variable (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    46	variable (g r₁ r₂ : ℕ)
    47	variable (b₁ : Module.Basis (Fin r₁) k
    48	  ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤))
    49	variable (b₂ : Module.Basis (Fin r₂) k
    50	  ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k ((windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
    51	    + (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)) ⊤))
    52	variable (i : (glueData k g r₁).J) (j : (glueData k g r₂).J)
    53	
    54	local notation "RZ" => DivCarveChartRing k
    55	  (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
    56	  (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j
    57	local notation "HS" => ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k
    58	  (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤)
    59	local notation "HMS" => ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k
    60	  ((windowM_choice π hπ g + windowS_choice π hπ g) • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤)
    61	local notation "K₁" => ↥(divUniversalFstWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule
    62	local notation "K₂" => ↥(divUniversalSndWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule
    63	
    64	/-- The `t`-th multiplier-basis component of the relative product map. -/
    65	noncomputable def universalMulComponent
    66	    (t : Fin (Module.finrank k HS)) : K₁ →ₗ[RZ] RZ ⊗[k] HMS :=
    67	  (LinearMap.baseChange RZ (windowShiftMul hπ g ((Module.finBasis k HS) t))).comp
    68	    (divUniversalFstWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule.subtype
    69	
    70	/-- Scalar extension commutes with the finite product used as the source of
    71	`universalMulMap`. -/
    72	noncomputable def universalMulSourceBaseChangeEquiv
    73	    (K : Type u) [CommRing K] [Algebra RZ K] :
    74	    K ⊗[RZ] universalMulSource C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j ≃ₗ[K]
    75	      Fin (Module.finrank k HS) → (K ⊗[RZ] K₁) :=
    76	  TensorProduct.piRight RZ K K (fun _ : Fin (Module.finrank k HS) => K₁)
    77	
    78	/-- Under `universalMulSourceBaseChangeEquiv`, the base-changed universal
    79	product map is the sum of its base-changed multiplier-basis components. -/
    80	theorem baseChange_universalMulMap_eq_sum
    81	    (K : Type u) [CommRing K] [Algebra RZ K] :
    82	    LinearMap.baseChange K (universalMulMap C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j)
    83	      = (∑ t : Fin (Module.finrank k HS),
    84	          (LinearMap.baseChange K
    85	            (universalMulComponent C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j t)).comp
    86	              (LinearMap.proj t)) ∘ₗ
    87	          (universalMulSourceBaseChangeEquiv C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j K).toLinearMap := by
    88	  apply LinearMap.ext
    89	  intro x
    90	  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    91	  | zero => simp
    92	  | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]
    93	  | tmul a v =>
    94	      simp [universalMulMap, universalMulComponent,
    95	        universalMulSourceBaseChangeEquiv, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    96	        LinearMap.baseChange_tmul]
    97	
    98	end AlgebraicGeometry

     8	/-!
     9	# G-4 -- persistence of the universal second fibre window under multiplication
    10	
    11	At a field point of a pair chart which kills the carve ideal, the P-fib pack identifies
    12	the two universal fibre windows with
    13	
    14	`K_M = H^0(O(N - D))` and `K' = H^0(O(N + S - D))`
    15	
    16	for the same effective degree-`g` divisor `D`.  The first equality also identifies `D`
    17	with the base divisor of `K_M` relative to `N`; the pack BPF-span theorem therefore says
    18	that multiplication by the full `S`-window spans all of `K'`.
    19	
    20	The main theorem is parameterized by the five abstract P-fib ledger hypotheses.  The
    21	second theorem discharges them from the transported-window ledger whenever
    22	`0 < windowBound`; no relative chart ideal or total-space flatness claim is made here.
    23	-/
    24	
    25	set_option autoImplicit false
    26	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    27	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    28	
    29	universe u
    30	
    31	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite
    32	open scoped TensorProduct
    33	
    34	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    35

    37	
    38	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    39	  Scheme.functionFieldOverModule

    42	section SecondWindow
    43	
    44	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    45	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    46	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi] [IsDominant pi]
    47	
    48	noncomputable local instance instOverCleftSecondWindow : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
    49	  ⟨C.hom⟩
    50	
    51	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsIntegral C.left]
    52	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    53	variable [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
    54	  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
    55	variable (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    56	variable (g r1 r2 : Nat)
    57	variable (b1 : Module.Basis (Fin r1) k
    58	  ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
    59	variable (b2 : Module.Basis (Fin r2) k
    60	  ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k ((windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
    61	    + (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)) ⊤))
    62	variable (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J)
    63	variable (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    64	  [Algebra (PairChartRing k g r1 g r2 i j) K]
    65	  [IsScalarTower k (PairChartRing k g r1 g r2 i j) K]

    72	    [Algebra k L] :
    73	    SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=

# SPEC DD-4 REDESIGN — the relative-achiever / relative-BPF feasibility verdict (2026-07-20, DESIGN lane)

Settles THE decisive feasibility question of the representability campaign: can the
DD-4 relative-achiever / relative-BPF seam be built, so that the G-4 seed's `hdvd`
(hence `divRep`) closes? Reads I-0288 (the current-construction inadequacy proof — the
"read first" note), I-0287/0284/0281 (the seed-close reductions), I-0272 (why Route-2
routed through the seed), I-0268/0264/0260/0258 (the achiever-lift history), I-0247
(the fibre-divisor keystone), I-0240 (SlicingFlatKernel), I-0244/0285 (SupportTube /
no-leak). Supersedes `informal/spec-dd4-seam.md` (I-0268): that worksheet's Route 2
was correct in spirit but its `relDivisor := seedUniv.localEquations` realization routed
through the seed's `dvd` (I-0272), so it did not dissolve the wall. This note carries the
construction the whole way. All `file:line` are verbatim spot-checks this pass.

---

## §0. Verdict box (read this first)

> **VERDICT: HARD-BUT-BUILDABLE.** The seam is SOUND and unblockable; there is NO
> impossibility. The recurring achiever-lift obstruction (I-0258) is **dissolved** — not by
> skipping the seed, but by lifting through a **surjection** instead of a rigid reduction.
> The essential content is one honest brick — **relative-local base-point-freeness by
> stalk-Nakayama** — sitting on the (landed-scoped) carve flat-rank-`g` engine. Realistic
> cost: **multi-week, ≈ 2 XL + 3 L + 2 M bricks** (§3). Not a bounded single-session win;
> not blocked.
>
> **RECOMMENDED ROUTE — keep the seed; redesign `(sec z, h z)` by surjection-lift +
> Nakayama-neighbourhood.** Consume the LANDED seed finale
> (`isGenerator_of_fibre_ne_zero`, `DivSchemeSeed.lean:188`; `divFamEps_certifiedFamily`,
> `DivSchemeEps.lean:312`) VERBATIM. The two pointwise fields I-0288 condemned become:
> * **(A) `sec z` — a relative achiever AT `z`**, built by lifting a κ(p)-fibre achiever
>   through the **surjection** `read ⊗ κ(p) : K_univ ⊗ κ(p) ↠ H⁰(N − d_p)`
>   (`divUniversalFibreKM_eq_span`, `DivSchemeSeedUnivRes.lean:376`) — NOT by reducing a
>   window vector to a chosen `f_p`. I-0258's "single window vector need not reduce to a
>   chosen κ(p)-combination" is TRUE but IRRELEVANT: we need SOME achiever at `z`, and the
>   surjection hits every element of `H⁰(N − d_p)`, achievers included. This is a clean
>   lift, not the "non-liftable" step the history feared.
> * **(B) `h z` — a genuine fibre-cutter `h z ∈ ann(N z)`**, `N z := J / (read sec z)`
>   (`J` = the base ideal `⟨K_univ readings⟩`), produced by `SupportTubeFinite` (`N z`
>   finite over `R_Z`, I-0244) at the point `z ∉ supp(N z)`. `ann(N z)` elements are
>   HONEST fibre-cutting sections — the missing "cut in the fibre, not the base" that
>   `algebraMap f` (`DivSchemeSeedUnivGen.lean:289`) could never provide (I-0288 fact 2).
>   `D(h z)` shrinks in the fibre to exactly the locus where `read sec z` achieves `d`, so
>   I-0288's razor `hle` (`DivSchemeUnivFibreHdiv.lean:203`) holds on all of `D(h z)`.
>
> **THE decisive question — does a carve-direct NON-SEED `relDivisor`/U1 dissolve the
> achiever-lift? Answer: the achiever-lift dissolves EITHER WAY (via the surjection, §1.2),
> so skipping the seed buys nothing and costs more.** A fully non-seed
> `CertifiedDivisorFamily` (build the base ideal `J` as a `Module.Invertible` line bundle
> over `Γ(relCurve)`, extract `LocalEquations.eqn` directly) IS possible in principle, but
> requires THREE bridges that are **absent** in mathlib and in-tree — "`Γ`-flat + fibrewise
> invertible ⟹ invertible", "rank-1 projective ⟹ `Module.Invertible`", "invertible ideal
> ⟹ single local generator `J·Γ_f = span{eqn}`" — and these are **Γ-local** (curve-local)
> reasoning that the landed engines (which are all **R_Z-fibrewise**) do NOT cover. The
> stalk-Nakayama route (§1.3) reaches the SAME local generator using only R_Z-fibrewise
> flatness + a one-point stalk Nakayama, reusing the maximal landed surface. **So: the
> carve does NOT hand you a relative divisor object; it hands you flatness. The divisor is
> always extracted as `J`'s local generator, and the cheapest extraction keeps the seed.**
>
> **What the carve does and does NOT give (settles task Q1a).** `divUniversal_carve` /
> `_residueField` (`DivSchemeFamilyUniv.lean:106/135`) produce **linear-algebra** data — a
> Grassmannian window pair `(K_M, K')` of submodules satisfying `carvePairArrow = 0` after
> every base change. This is NOT a relative section, NOT a relative subscheme, NOT an ideal
> sheaf. It pins `d` **fibrewise** (`d_p = divUniversalSeedFibreDivisor`,
> `DivSchemeSeedUnivFields.lean:133`; `_spec:146`) and, via `SlicingFlatKernel`, delivers
> the **relative flatness** of `Γ/J`. It does NOT yield a per-`z` relative section without
> the Nakayama-neighbourhood step (§1.3). There is no free lunch, but no wall either.

## §1. The construction — statement pins

Throughout: `R_Z := DivCarveChartRing …` (Noetherian, `isNoetherianRing_divCarveChartRing`,
`DivSchemeFamilyUniv.lean:60`); `K_univ := divUniversalSeedK …` (finite projective,
`finite_divUniversalSeedK`, `DivSchemeSeedUniv.lean:315`); `N := windowN` (`= Θᴹ`);
`d_p := divUniversalSeedFibreDivisor` the fibre base divisor of degree `g`; the fibre
window `divUniversalFibreKM p = H⁰(N − d_p)` (`_spec`, `DivSchemeSeedUnivFields.lean:146`).
`read := relThetaResSide a b …` the side-component reading; `J z :=` the base ideal
`⟨read ψ : ψ ∈ K_univ⟩ ⊆ Γ(relCurve C R_Z, chart)` (the ideal implicit in `hdvd`).

### §1.1 What `hdvd` is, and the razor it was reduced to (LANDED)

The seed's `hdvd` (`DivSchemeSeed.lean:189–190`): `∀ z, ∀ ψ ∈ K_univ,
read ψ ∈ Ideal.span {read (sec z)}` on the piece `D(h z)`. I-0287 reduced this, over the
fibre field `K = κ(p)`, to a single pointwise order inequality via
`relThetaResSide_mem_span_of_forall_ord_le` (`DivSchemeUnivFibreHdiv.lean:203`) +
`germ_relThetaResSide_dvd_iff_ord_le` (`:170`):

```
hle : ∀ w ≠ η closed in D(h'),  ord (read ψ)_w  ≤  ord (read (sec z))_w        (RAZOR)
```

`hle ⟺ read(sec z)` **achieves the ceiling** `ord = divisorBound(N − d_p)_w` at every
`w ∈ D(h')` (I-0288 fact 3). With the OLD `h z = algebraMap f`, `D(h') =` the whole fibre
chart (`relPinnedSectionsMap_algebraMap_eq`, `DivSchemeSeedUnivFacts.lean:212`; I-0288
fact 2), so `hle` demanded achievement on the WHOLE chart — impossible for a merely
non-vanishing `sec z` with its `deg N − g > 0` extra zeros (I-0288). **The redesign makes
`D(h')` a fibre-neighbourhood that EXCLUDES those extra zeros — then `hle` holds.**

### §1.2 (A) `sec z` = a relative achiever at `z` — the surjection lift (dissolves I-0258)

```
-- the achiever exists at z's fibre point (LANDED field infra):
v_p ∈ H⁰(N − d_p),  ord (v_p)_z = 0        -- Scheme.exists_coeffAt_eq_baseDivisorAt
                                            --   (BaseDivisor.lean:143); bd(H⁰(N−d_p)) = 0
                                            --   by the normalization le_divisorSections_sub_baseDivisor (:160)
-- read ⊗ κ(p) is SURJECTIVE onto the fibre window (LANDED span law):
read ⊗ κ(p) : K_univ ⊗ κ(p) ↠ H⁰(N − d_p)   -- image = span = window (divUniversalFibreKM_eq_span, Res:376)
-- lift a preimage of v_p through K_univ ↠ K_univ ⊗ κ(p) (projective; cheap):
sec z ∈ K_univ  with  (read (sec z)) ⊗ κ(p) = v_p     -- ⟹ read(sec z) generates J̄_p at z
```

**Why this is NOT the I-0258 wall.** I-0258/0260 flag that a single window vector's fibre
image need not equal a *chosen* `f_p` (`windowCompare` is only semilinear, its κ(p)-SPAN is
the window). Correct — but we do not need `read(sec z)` to equal a *particular* `f_p`; we
need it to be *some* achiever at `z`. The span law makes `read ⊗ κ(p)` **surjective**, so
every window element — every achiever — has a preimage. We choose the preimage. This is the

   311	                b₁.equivFun.symm.toLinearMap
   312	              (windowCompare (PairChartRing k g r₁ g r₂ i j)
   313	                (DivCarveChartRing k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   314	                  (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j) n)) ''
   315	            ((pairTautFst k g r₁ r₂ i j).toSubmodule :
   316	              Set (TensorProduct k (PairChartRing k g r₁ g r₂ i j) (Fin r₁ → k)))) := by
   317	  have h0 : (divUniversalFstWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule
   318	      = Submodule.map
   319	          (LinearMap.baseChange
   320	            (DivCarveChartRing k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   321	              (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j)
   322	            b₁.equivFun.symm.toLinearMap)
   323	          (divUniversalFst k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   324	            (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule :=
   325	    congrAmbient_toSubmodule b₁.equivFun.symm
   326	      (divUniversalFst k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   327	        (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j)
   328	  rw [h0, divUniversalFst_toSubmodule_eq_span C hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j,
   329	    Submodule.map_span, ← Set.image_comp]
   330	  rfl

   371	/-- **THE SEAM KEYSTONE** (worksheet §1.5 (b), I-0247 step (b)): at any field point `K`
   372	of the tower `R_{I,J} → R_Z → K`, the fibre window `divUniversalFibreKM` is the
   373	`K`-span of the `Φ`-read fibre comparisons of the elements of the universal window
   374	`divUniversalFstWindow` — `K_univ ⊗ κ(q)` spans the fibre window, so fibre-window data
   375	(achievers, nonvanishing) is realized by relative seed sections. -/
   376	theorem divUniversalFibreKM_eq_span :
   377	    divUniversalFibreKM C hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ i j K
   378	      = Submodule.span K
   379	          ((fun x => divFamPhi C K π (windowM_choice π hπ g)
   380	              (relThetaPairH1_windowM C π hπ g)
   381	              (windowCompare
   382	                (DivCarveChartRing k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   383	                  (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j)
   384	                K x)) ''
   385	            ((divUniversalFstWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule :
   386	              Set (TensorProduct k
   387	                (DivCarveChartRing k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   388	                  (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j)
   389	                ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k
   390	                  (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤)))) := by
   391	  -- the right side: the window as a span, collapsed through the semilinear `Φ ∘ ρ`
   392	  rw [divUniversalFstWindow_toSubmodule_eq_span C hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j,
   393	    span_image_span_of_algebraMap_smul
   394	      (F := fun x => divFamPhi C K π (windowM_choice π hπ g)
   395	        (relThetaPairH1_windowM C π hπ g)
   396	        (windowCompare
   397	          (DivCarveChartRing k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   398	            (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j) K x))
   399	      (by rw [map_zero, map_zero])
   400	      (fun x y => by rw [map_add, map_add])
   401	      (fun r y => by rw [windowCompare_smul, map_smul])
   402	      _,
   403	    ← Set.image_comp]
   404	  -- the left side: the kernel-span seam at `K` over the pair chart ring, pushed
   405	  -- through the boundary equivalence and `Φ`
   406	  rw [divUniversalFibreKM,
   407	    Grassmannian.ker_baseChangeMkQ_eq_span_windowCompare
   408	      (pairTautFst k g r₁ r₂ i j).toSubmodule K,
   409	    Submodule.map_span, Submodule.map_span, ← Set.image_comp, ← Set.image_comp]
   410	  -- generatorwise agreement: naturality of the comparison + the tower law
   411	  refine congrArg (Submodule.span K) (Set.image_congr fun n _ => ?_)
   412	  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
   413	  rw [baseChange_linearEquiv_apply, windowCompare_baseChange,
   414	    windowCompare_windowCompare]

   421	/-- **The elementwise forward seam**: the `Φ`-read fibre comparison of any element of
   422	the universal window lies in the fibre window. -/
   423	theorem divFamPhi_windowCompare_mem_divUniversalFibreKM
   424	    {x : TensorProduct k
   425	      (DivCarveChartRing k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   426	        (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j)
   427	      ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤)}
   428	    (hx : x ∈ (divUniversalFstWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule) :
   429	    divFamPhi C K π (windowM_choice π hπ g) (relThetaPairH1_windowM C π hπ g)
   430	        (windowCompare
   431	          (DivCarveChartRing k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   432	            (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j) K x)
   433	      ∈ divUniversalFibreKM C hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ i j K := by
   434	  rw [divUniversalFibreKM_eq_span C hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j K]
   435	  exact Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hx)
   436

    57	/-- The coordinate second universal window is the span of the compared
    58	tautological second kernel. -/
    59	private theorem divUniversalSnd_toSubmodule_eq_span_aux :
    60	    (divUniversalSnd k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
    61	        (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule
    62	      = Submodule.span RZ
    63	          (windowCompare (PairChartRing k g r₁ g r₂ i j) RZ ''
    64	            ((pairTautSnd k g r₁ r₂ i j).toSubmodule :
    65	              Set (TensorProduct k (PairChartRing k g r₁ g r₂ i j) (Fin r₂ → k)))) := by
    66	  letI : Algebra (PairChartRing k g r₁ g r₂ i j) RZ :=
    67	    (divCarveChartMk k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
    68	      (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toAlgebra
    69	  letI : IsScalarTower k (PairChartRing k g r₁ g r₂ i j) RZ :=
    70	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' <| IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k _ _
    71	  have h1 := Module.Grassmannian.map_toSubmodule
    72	    (divCarveChartMk k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
    73	      (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j)
    74	    (pairTautSnd k g r₁ r₂ i j)
    75	  refine ((show (divUniversalSnd k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
    76	      (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule = _

    84	/-- The second universal window in the transported `H_{M+s}` ambient is
    85	the span of the compared tautological second-kernel generators. -/
    86	theorem divUniversalSndWindow_toSubmodule_eq_span :
    87	    (divUniversalSndWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule
    88	      = Submodule.span RZ
    89	          ((fun n =>
    90	              LinearMap.baseChange RZ
    91	                (b₂.equivFun.symm.trans (seedWindowShiftEquiv C π hπ g)).toLinearMap
    92	                (windowCompare (PairChartRing k g r₁ g r₂ i j) RZ n)) ''
    93	            ((pairTautSnd k g r₁ r₂ i j).toSubmodule :
    94	              Set (TensorProduct k (PairChartRing k g r₁ g r₂ i j) (Fin r₂ → k)))) := by
    95	  have h0 : (divUniversalSndWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule
    96	      = Submodule.map
    97	          (LinearMap.baseChange RZ
    98	            (b₂.equivFun.symm.trans (seedWindowShiftEquiv C π hπ g)).toLinearMap)
    99	          (divUniversalSnd k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   100	            (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule :=
   101	    congrAmbient_toSubmodule
   102	      (b₂.equivFun.symm.trans (seedWindowShiftEquiv C π hπ g))
   103	      (divUniversalSnd k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   104	        (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j)
   105	  rw [h0, divUniversalSnd_toSubmodule_eq_span_aux C hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j,
   106	    Submodule.map_span, ← Set.image_comp]
   107	  rfl
